Package gui

Class PayBillController

java.lang.Object
gui.BaseTerminalController
gui.PayBillController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initializable
public class PayBillController extends BaseTerminalController implements Initializable
Controller for the Pay Bill screen in the BistroNine application. This class handles the logic for searching, displaying, and processing bill payments. It is designed to be reusable across different contexts, such as the Guest Terminal or the User Dashboard. Key functionalities include: - Searching for bills using a reservation confirmation code. - Displaying detailed bill information including discounts. - Simulating credit card payment processing through a dialog. - Handling communication with the server for bill retrieval and payment.
